passplan 1
file "<root>/offscreen.fx"
device HAL backbuffer=1000x600 format=A8R8G8B8 depthstencil=D24S8 vs=3.0 ps=3.0 mipfilter=1
load ok
effect scriptclass=2 scriptorder=0 posteffect=0 drawsgeometry=0 errors=0
parameters 10
param "Script" "STANDARDSGLOBAL" scalar float 1x1
  ann "ScriptOutput" string0 = "color"
  ann "ScriptClass" string0 = "sceneorobject"
  ann "ScriptOrder" string0 = "standard"
  ann "Script" string0 = "Technique=Main?Used:Missing:Other;"
param "matWorld" "" matrix_rows float 4x4
param "DifColor" "" vector float 1x4
param "transp" "" scalar bool 1x1
param "SubsetCount" "" scalar int 1x1
param "Morph" "CONTROLOBJECT" scalar float 1x1
  ann "name" string0 = "ctrl.pmx"
  ann "item" string0 = "Morph"
param "Bone" "CONTROLOBJECT" matrix_rows float 4x4
  ann "name" string0 = "(self)"
  ann "item" string0 = "Root"
param "WorldViewProjMatrix" "WORLDVIEWPROJECTION" matrix_rows float 4x4
param "MirrorRT" "OFFSCREENRENDERTARGET" object texture 0x0
  ann "Description" string0 = "Mirror"
  ann "ViewportRatio" float2 = 1,1
  ann "ClearColor" float4 = 1,0.5,0,1
  ann "ClearDepth" float1 = 1
  ann "AntiAlias" bool1 = 0
  ann "DefaultEffect" string0 = "self=hide; *=none; "
param "CubeRT" "RENDERCOLORTARGET" object texture 0x0
  ann "Width" int1 = 128
  ann "Height" int1 = 128
  ann "ResourceType" string0 = "Cube"
  ann "Format" string0 = "A8R8G8B8"
resources 2
resource "MirrorRT" semantic=OffScreenRenderTarget texture=5
  request 1000x600x1 mips=1 rawsize=1000x600 rawmips=1 format=A8R8G8B8 defaultpool=1
  clear color=0xffff7f00 depth=1 antialias=0
  defaulteffect_row "self" "hide"
  defaulteffect_row "*" "none"
  created texture 1000x600 levels=1 format=A8R8G8B8 pool=0 usage=0x1
  offscreendepth 1000x600 format=D24S8
resource "CubeRT" semantic=RenderColorTarget texture=9
  request 128x128x1 mips=1 rawsize=128x128 rawmips=1 format=A8R8G8B8 defaultpool=1
  created cube 128x128 levels=1 format=A8R8G8B8 pool=0 usage=0x1
controls 2
control "Morph" name="ctrl.pmx" item="Morph"
control "Bone" name="(self)" item="Root"
technique_order "Used" "Other"
techniques 2
technique "Used" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=1
  script "RenderColorTarget0=CubeRT[2]; Clear=Color; Pass=P0; RenderColorTarget0=;"
  cmd 0 RenderColorTarget0 param="CubeRT" value=2 text="CubeRT[2]"
  cmd 1 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 2 Pass pass="P0" index=0 text="P0"
  cmd 3 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  pass 0 "P0" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "Other" mmdpass=edge usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=0 passes=1
  pass 0 "P0" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
selection subsets=2 clamped=0
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "Used" "Used" "Used" "Used" "Used" "Used" "Used" "Used"
  select object_ss 0-1 - - - - - - - -
  select shadow 0-1 -
  select edge 0-1 "Other"
  select zplot 0-1 -
runs
  run "Used"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "P0" rt0=CubeRT[2] rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=128x128+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
  run "Other"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "P0" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
enginelog "Loading effect file: <root>/offscreen.fx"
enginelog "Warning: unknown technique name: Missing  (parameter: Script)"
enginelog "Info: new OffScreen RenderTarget: MirrorRT"
end
